CustomField.description: This field was created so the time format could be displayed as HH:MM so it will be displayed properly when a document is created in DocGen. PacPoint: 00011749
CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(EstimatedDepartureTime5__c), "", IF( MOD(HOUR(EstimatedDepartureTime5__c),12)=0, "12", TEXT(MOD(HOUR(EstimatedDepartureTime5__c),12)) ) & ":" & IF( MINUTE(EstimatedDepartureTime5__c) < 10, "0" & TEXT(MINUTE(EstimatedDepartureTime5__c)), TEXT(MINUTE(EstimatedDepartureTime5__c)) ) & IF( HOUR(EstimatedDepartureTime5__c) < 12, " AM", " PM" ) )
CustomField.label: Estimated Departure Time
